sql004: CREATE TABLE provider_proof_artifacts(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(hash)=64 AND hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('account_session','reviewed_policy','media_quote','execution_session')),canonical_payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(canonical_payload) AND length(CAST(canonical_payload AS BLOB))<=262144),created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at)='integer' AND created_at BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799999),CHECK(json_extract(canonical_payload,'$.schemaVersion') IS 1 AND json_extract(canonical_payload,'$.kind') IS kind));

CREATE TABLE provider_credential_generations(provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),generation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,account_id TEXT NOT NULL,credential_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(credential_fingerprint)=64 AND credential_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),changed_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(changed_at)='integer' AND changed_at BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799999),PRIMARY KEY(provider_id,revision),UNIQUE(provider_id,revision,generation_id));

CREATE TABLE provider_credential_heads(provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,generation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,FOREIGN KEY(provider_id,revision,generation_id) REFERENCES provider_credential_generations(provider_id,revision,generation_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE provider_quote_proofs(budget_quote_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES budget_quotes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,media_quote_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'quote' CHECK(media_quote_kind='quote'),media_quote_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,artifact_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES provider_proof_artifacts(hash) ON DELETE RESTRICT,FOREIGN KEY(media_quote_kind,media_quote_id) REFERENCES records(kind,id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE provider_execution_proofs(execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES budget_executions(execution_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,reservation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES budget_reservations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,artifact_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES provider_proof_artifacts(hash) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

For each table provider_proof_artifacts/provider_credential_generations/provider_quote_proofs/provider_execution_proofs create BEFORE UPDATE and BEFORE DELETE triggers that RAISE(ABORT,'immutable provider proof'). Heads have BEFORE DELETE reject; BEFORE INSERT require revision1; BEFORE UPDATE require same provider_id, NEW.revision=OLD.revision+1, new generation_id distinct, new history.changed_at>=old history.changed_at and changed account_id OR credential_fingerprint. methodSemantics.reads: Validate schema/hash on every artifact load; generation joins head/history. Absent link=>null; malformed present link=>sanitized integrity error. Validate link associations below on insert/read; historical reads ignore current head/clock.
methodSemantics.append: Exact validated immutable replay=>original,created:false; conflicting same ID or unique association=>throw. Validate before insert using atomic/savepoint pattern; propagate errors to outer transaction.
methodSemantics.CAS: Absent head: expected null/candidate revision1. Current n: expected n/new revision n+1/new generation ID/account or fingerprint changed/changedAt nondecreasing. Exact installed candidate replay returns true only with original expected revision (null for1,otherwise revision-1). Stale expectation=>false/no writes. Fresh success atomically appends immutable history then updates head. Same binding is reused via read. UNIQUE historical generation ID prevents ABA resurrection.
methodSemantics.quoteLink: Require media_quote artifact snapshots canonical-equal existing mediaQuote,BudgetQuote,binding,AccountEvidence; all link/relation IDs match. Evidence reference=sha256:accountProofHash. Referenced account_session provider/account/generation/session/time exactly matches pinned evidence/binding/quote session. Reviewed_policy same provider, quote created/expiry within account/policy/capability limits. Missing/wrong-kind/mismatched data reject before link insert. Storage grants no spend permission.
methodSemantics.executionLink: Require execution_session and exact registered execution/reservation/job; requestHash=job.requestHash=hash(job.snapshot),execution.executionSemanticHash=job.requestSnapshot.resultTarget.inputsHash. Quote/binding/evidence IDs equal reservation; quoteProofHash equals quote link artifact; generation/provider/account match pinned quote/reservation. Referenced worker account_session matches generation/session,role worker,time validity. SDK/adapter/capability provider/model and quote/policy expiry agree. C/P still check authoritative semantics/current state/actual client.
methodSemantics.atomicAggregate: C outer quote TX inserts media once+artifacts+AccountEvidence+BudgetQuote/binding+QuoteProofLink; admission TX inserts execution/reservation+artifact/link. Errors propagate and roll back ALL new records. S methods never create media/authorization/reservation; S owns no draft.
